correctness.rationale: For projection symbols P,Q, Gaussian Fock composition projections are bosonic Γ(P), Γ(Q) on all symmetric tensor degrees. Restrict Γ(P)Γ(Q) to Γ(Q) range: positive singular values are occupation products t_alpha of positive one-particle principal cosines c_j, including vacuum. Each t in (0,1) yields a two-projection canonical 2x2 commutator block with singular values t sqrt(1−t^2) twice and eigenvalues ± i times this. Counting occupation indices correctly handles collisions, unit overlap and zero angles. If E∩F=0 all positive c_j<1 and polynomially many degree-n terms decay geometrically, giving compactness/all S_p; if there is a common direction and noncommuting principal angle, infinitely repeated nonzero singular value gives noncompactness/essential norm equals norm. Squaring and summing geometric series gives 2(product(1−c_j^2)^−1 − product(1−c_j^4)^−1). Difference of rank-one successive squares has sign (1+q)q^k−1, yielding maximizing degree including tie. Independent finite power sums checked.
